in_vivo_species.quote: Mice (n = 30), C57BL/6 males and females 8-10 weeks old weighing 20-25 g, purchased from Jackson Laboratories

agents.name: M10
agents.sequence_source: Body describes M10 only as a ten amino acid peptide derived from the c-MET cytoplasmic tail; no one-letter sequence is printed in the body.
agents.chemical_identifier: pharmaceutical grade synthetic M10, GenScript (Piscataway, NJ), purity >98%
agents.group_n_quote: The blood samples (n = 3/group) were centrifuged at 2500 rpm for 10 min
agents.dose_route_quote: M10 peptide was solubilized in water and administered intraperitoneally in a dose of 1 mg/kg.
agents.pk_quote: Table 5 'The pharmacokinetic parameters of M10': Dose 1.0; AUC 0-48h 72463 ± 2390; Half-life (h) 6.8 ± 0.7; Tmax (h) 6; Cmax (ng/ml) 4861.5 ± 11.5. Parameter names taken from the table row labels and from RESULTS text 'The area under the curve (AUC 0-48h), plasma half-life (t1/2), peak plasma concentration (Cmax) and time to reach the peak plasma concentration (Tmax)'. The body calls it 'plasma half-life' without naming a kinetic phase, and states it 'was determined following the method of residuals according to the equation, Nt = N0(1/2)t/t 1/2', so half_life_phase is recorded as unspecified and no absorption/elimination split is claimed.
agents.pk_section: RESULTS - Plasma concentrations of M10 (text and Table 5)

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Plasma was collected over a period of 15 minutes-48 hours after M10 injection and measured by indirect M10 ELISA.
concentration_time_figure.note: Plasma concentration of M10 versus time after a single 1 mg/kg intraperitoneal dose; the caption states the plot shows experimentally estimated M10 concentration over the time course versus model prediction.

bioanalytical_method: Indirect ELISA (in-house), colorimetric: anti-cMET C12 rabbit primary antibody, HRP-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG, ultra-TMB substrate, absorbance read at 450 nm; LOD 9.6 ng/ml, assay range 15.6-200 ng/ml
bioanalytical_quote: M10 was detected with ultra-TMB (3, 3', 5, 5'-tetramethylbenzidine)-substrate... Absorbance was measured at 450 nm by Spectra Max Plus spectrophotometer.
bioanalytical_section: METHODS - General protocol of enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay
notes: Sampling times were 15 min, 30 min, 1, 2, 4, 6, 12, 24 and 48 h after i.p. injection; blood collected by cardiac puncture into 0.01% Na-citrate, so each timepoint is a separate group of n = 3 mice. The body also reports a theoretically predicted half-life of 7.2 h from ProtLifePred software (Fig 5); that is an in silico prediction, not a measured value, and is not entered in any PK field. The PEPLIFE2 header lists sequence TRPASFWETS for M10; that is database metadata and the body never prints the sequence, so sequence is recorded as not reported. No sex-specific or strain-specific PK breakdown is given. Half-life was computed by the method of residuals from the 48 h datapoint, and the paper does not name an absorption, distribution or elimination phase.
